module: ImGui debug window for on-screen messages ("Message" UI events). It lets you compose a message (text, category, icon, duration in seconds), send it via guihooks.message, clear a category or all messages, and enable a TTL bypass on the UI side. Useful for testing the display of messages and [action=...] bindings.
notes: guihooks events emitted: Message (with clear = true to clear a category), ClearAllMessages, MessagesDebug ({bypassTtl}).
The "Regex clear" checkbox has no effect: both branches of _clearCategory send the same event (the category is therefore used as is).
The "Test 3 Messages" button sends three messages in the categories <category>.1, .2 and .3 with durations of 3, 4 and 5 s.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame; draws the window if it is open (nothing otherwise).
